Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.domain.social

Record Class ProviderTrust

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.domain.social.ProviderTrust
Record Components:
provider - provider the setting belongs to.
trustMfa - whether the provider's multi-factor claim is trusted.
public record ProviderTrust(IdentityProvider provider, boolean trustMfa) extends Record
How far a provider's own multi-factor authentication is trusted. By default a federated sign-in is a primary factor and the normal second-factor flow applies; only a provider marked as trusted, whose upstream amr claim proves mfa, is accepted as a strong sign-in on its own.
